title: Sending Payments from a Pocketwire Personal Account: Status and Limits
content:
**Rule.** A payment can be sent from a Pocketwire Personal Account only while the account status is active. A single payment may not exceed the plan's per-payment send limit. The rolling 7-day total of payments sent plus the new payment may not exceed the effective weekly limit, which is the approved weekly send limit when one is recorded on the account and otherwise the plan's weekly send limit.

**The rolling 7-day total** is the sum of the payments sent from the account on the handling date and the six preceding calendar days, Eastern Time, leaving out payments that were refunded as unclaimed invitations.

**Post-recovery period.** During the post-recovery period — from the recovered date through the plan's post-recovery period in calendar days later — the effective weekly limit is replaced by the lower of itself and the plan's post-recovery weekly send cap.

**Credit card funding.** A payment funded by a linked credit card is allowed only on plans whose credit card funding is available.

**Breach.** A payment that would breach any of these limits is declined in full — it is never split or partially sent — and nothing is booked; the customer may send a smaller amount or wait until earlier payments leave the rolling window.

**Invitations.** Payments to a recipient who is not yet registered are sent as invitations (recipient status unclaimed invitation) and count toward the limits from the day they are sent.

**Completed payments.** A completed personal payment to a registered recipient cannot be reversed by Pocketwire when the customer sent it to the wrong person or changed their mind; the customer may request the money back from the recipient in the app, and such a payment is not an unauthorized payment.

### Quantities, restated

- The remaining weekly capacity is the effective weekly limit less the rolling 7-day total, and never below 0.00.
- A payment is within the limits when its amount is at or below both the per-payment send limit and the remaining weekly capacity.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

An active account with no approved weekly send limit, on a plan with a weekly send limit of 7000.00 and a per-payment send limit of 4999.99, has sent 6500.00 over the handling date and the six preceding days.

| New payment | Remaining weekly capacity | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00 | 500.00 | Within the limits |
| 600.00 | 500.00 | Declined in full; nothing is booked |
| 5000.00 with no earlier payments in the window | 7000.00 | Declined in full — above the per-payment limit |

The same account in its post-recovery period, on a plan whose post-recovery weekly send cap is 1000.00, has an effective weekly limit of 1000.00, the lower of 7000.00 and 1000.00.
